screen_model: KBM-7 near-haploid human CML cells with inducible Cas9

screen_model: K562 human chronic myelogenous leukemia cells constitutively expressing Cas9
library_design: Custom genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 library with approximately four sgRNAs per human protein-coding gene plus approximately 2,000 negative controls
treatment_contrast: 48 nM GSK983 versus untreated for 10-14 days; sensitization and protection phenotypes
screen_replication: Not reported; one treated and one untreated pooled K562 population are described
analysis_method: Median fold-change in sgRNA frequency between untreated and GSK983-treated populations followed by gene ranking
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Dataset 2 contains complete CRISPR-Cas9 gene rankings derived from guide fold changes, not guide-by-sample counts
rights_basis: PMC provides an author manuscript for academic reading and data-mining under Nature terms; no affirmative open redistribution license was found for Supplementary Dataset 2 or underlying sequencing data
validation_source_locator: Figure 1H-I and Supplementary Figure 4A: individual sgRNA retests in K562 reproduce sensitization for NPRL2 and DEPDC5 and protection for COQ10B, COQ9 and PDSS2; target loss and same-gene rescue are not reported
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: All five genes remain V1 because matched K562 follow-up reproduced the expected GSK983 phenotype but did not document target editing or protein loss and did not include a same-gene rescue; PDSS2 had one individually retested sgRNA.
